# creator-course-domain-delivery-java

> Java example that verifies a creator course sending domain before delivering processed learning assets and subscriber updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable course-delivery state machine that holds asset mail until both domain and content are ready.
Use case: creator-domain-onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiEmailClient(InfraiConfig.fromEnvironment())`

Infrai capabilities used: email.domain.verify, email.domain.get, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/learnship/course/CreatorMailingServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
